Wrap the value in a useDebounce hook. It returns the latest value once it stops changing for delay milliseconds.tsxexport function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 300) {  const [debounced, setDebounced] = React.useState(value)
  React.useEffect(() => {    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay)    return () => clearTimeout(timeout)  }, [value, delay])
  return debounced}Pass the debounced value to your fetch instead of the raw input.

How do I debounce a search input in React?

Wrap the value in a useDebounce hook. It returns the latest value once it stops changing for delay milliseconds.tsxexport function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 300) {  const [debounced, setDebounced] = React.useState(value)
  React.useEffect(() => {    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delay)    return () => clearTimeout(timeout)  }, [value, delay])
  return debounced}Pass the debounced value to your fetch instead of the raw input.
